title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: a complex analytic space X (in the motivating case the Deligne-Mumford-Knudsen compactification of M_{g,ν}, or rather its stack or a finite cover) with a normal-crossings divisor Θ. The goal is to describe the homotopy type 'at infinity' of the open part X \ Θ by gluing simpler 'pieces de construction'.

The objects D_{d_0,...,d_r} index the stratification by multiplicity. The most natural reading: D_d is the space of pairs (x, S), with S a set of d local branches of Θ at x. This is the normalization of the d-fold self-intersection locus. D_{d_0,...,d_r} is the space of points x with a chain of branch sets S_0 ⊃ S_1 ⊃ ... ⊃ S_r, where |S_i| = d_i. Letting the chain vary makes D_• a simplicial analytic space. Face operators forget a member of the chain. Degeneracy operators repeat a member, and they are isomorphisms: D_{d_0,d_0} ≅ D_{d_0}, D_{d_0,d_1,d_1} ≅ D_{d_0,d_1}.

The previous page introduced the tubular-neighbourhood types V_{d*,d'*} (and their 'deleted' versions V*_{d*,d'*}) for nested index sequences d'_* ⊂ d_*. They are neighbourhoods of D*_{d'_*} related to D_{d'_*}. This page declares these V's and V*'s to be the building blocks.

The page is then a notational normalization:
(1) To remove degeneracy redundancy, require strictly decreasing indices d_0 > ... > d_r. Then the only simplicial operators kept are those coming from inclusions of standard simplices, i.e. composites of face maps. In modern terms, one passes from a simplicial to a semi-simplicial object (indexed by Δ_inj).
(2) Since the empty branch set is unique, D_{d,0} ≅ D_d, and more generally D_{d_0,...,d_r,0} ≅ D_{d_0,...,d_r} when d_r > 0. To remove this redundancy, require d_r > 0 whenever r ≥ 1. The only object carrying the index 0 is then D_0 = X.
(3) The face maps that would land in a '...,0' term are thereby lost. So one must add by hand the projections D_{d_*} → D_0 = X. Equivalently, regard every D_{d_*} as an analytic space over X, with the simplicial operators X-morphisms.

The marginal note suggests that one could instead restrict to formal neighbourhoods (completions or germs) along the images of the simplicial operators φ_{d*,d'*}.

The next page carries this out for X = affine line (analytic), Θ = {0}. It obtains the pieces C*, the germ of a disc D, and the punctured disc germ D*. The whole construction is a combinatorial presentation of the 'boundary homotopy type': a diagram of torus-bundle-like deleted tubular neighbourhoods over the strata, indexed by chains of strata. Its homotopy colimit recovers the end of X \ Θ.
errors: No mathematical error on this page; the identifications D_{d,d} ≅ D_d and D_{d_*,0} ≅ D_{d_*} are correct under the 'chains of branch sets' interpretation.

Minor gap: once the 0-index is suppressed, the added projections D_{d_*} → X must be checked to be compatible with the face maps. Grothendieck asserts this implicitly by saying the D_{d_*} are spaces over X.
Strictly, imposing d_0 > ... > d_r discards degeneracies, so one gets a semi-simplicial rather than simplicial object. This is harmless for homotopy colimits but is not stated.

ideas.what: Simplicial (flag-indexed) space of multiplicity strata D_{d_0,...,d_r} of a normal crossings divisor, with degeneracies being isomorphisms
ideas.modern_name: Semi-simplicial resolution / normalization of strata of an NCD (cf. Deligne's simplicial resolutions in Hodge III; poset-of-strata diagrams)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Deligne (Théorie de Hodge II/III, 1971-74) for NCD strata normalizations; general stratified-space literature

ideas.what: Normalizing the indexing: strictly decreasing indices and no trailing 0, with explicit structure maps to X added
ideas.modern_name: Restriction to Δ_inj (semi-simplicial objects) over a base

ideas.what: Tubular and deleted-tubular neighbourhood types V_{d*,d'*}, V*_{d*,d'*} as 'building blocks' of the structure at infinity of M_{g,ν}
ideas.modern_name: Homotopy-colimit decomposition of the link/boundary of an NCD complement (Kato-Nakayama space, real oriented blow-up, exit-path/stratified homotopy type); boundary pieces of moduli space in the Teichmüller-tower picture
ideas.usually_credited_to: Kato-Nakayama (1999); Harvey (1981) / Ivanov for curve-complex boundary; Esquisse-inspired work (Hatcher-Lochak-Schneps, Nakamura) for the tower
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme (1984) discusses structure at infinity of M_{g,ν} and the Teichmüller tower only in outline

ideas.what: Marginal remark: restrict to formal neighbourhoods along images of simplicial operators
ideas.modern_name: Formal/germ neighbourhoods of strata (formal completion along a stratum)

deep.surprise_reason: The page is purely notational bookkeeping: normalizing the indices of a semi-simplicial diagram of strata and adding projections to X. The underlying program (a combinatorial description of the structure at infinity of M_{g,ν} via tubular pieces) is interesting. But this page contains no new result, and its ideas are standard and well covered by later work on NCD strata and boundary homotopy types.
transcription_corrections: '(ce qui indique qu'on borne : des op. simpliciales...' is more likely '(ce qui implique qu'on se borne aux op. simpliciales qui correspondent à des inclusions de simplexes types — donc : aux composés d'op. face)'.
'Il faut donc compléter implicites [?]' is likely 'Il faut donc compléter implicitement'.
In the parenthesis on degeneracies, the inserted word above the line is 'simpl.': '(les op. de dégénérescence simpl. sont des iso !)'.
The left-margin note is hard to read. It seems to say 'On aurait pu se borner aux voisinages (complétés) formels le long de l'image des op. simpliciales φ_{d*,d'*}'; treat as tentative.
The crossed-out word at the bottom is illegible; the transcription's [-...-] is appropriate.
